enable_prompt_expansion.description: Let the model rewrite the prompt with more detail before rendering. Turn off for tighter control over the wording.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Prompt Expansion

enable_thinking.description: Reason about the prompt before rendering. Improves quality on complex layouts and long prompts at the cost of generation time. Requires prompt expansion.
enable_thinking.title: Thinking

input_images.description: Optional input images to edit or combine. The output keeps the aspect ratio of the last image unless an aspect ratio is chosen. Reference them in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, etc. Up to 3 images.
input_images.title: Input Images

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the image.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

num_images.description: Number of images to generate, 1 to 6. Only the first is returned; all are billed.
num_images.title: Number of Images

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate, or the edit to apply. Up to 4,500 tokens. Use @Image1, @Image2, etc. to reference the input images.
prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.x-workbench-default: A retro travel poster reading "OXEN" in bold condensed type, an ox on a mountain ridge at golden hour, clean vector illustration with a balanced layout

watermark.description: Add an AI-generated watermark in the bottom-right corner.
watermark.title: Watermark
